cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set G1 (it asks for 2026-27 and the 'not available' box is not ticked): tuition $50,580 (the same for all undergraduates and for international students; per credit hour $1,582, 12-18 credits), required fees $2,322, on-campus food and housing $14,930 (housing only $8,460 + food only $6,470). Estimated expenses: books and supplies $1,200, transportation $1,000, other $2,500 (other costs shown = transportation + other). Creighton's tuition page lists the same tuition for 2026-27 and a cost of attendance of $67,832 for entering Arts and Sciences freshmen ($68,172 Heider College of Business, $69,356 traditional nursing); those totals cover tuition, fees, and food and housing only. CDS H6: only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 75 degree-seeking undergraduate nonresidents received it, average $41,313.

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class): 6,389 applied, 5,888 admitted (92.2%), 1,248 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international / 2 of unknown residence) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 145 applied, 126 admitted, 16 enrolled. Wait list: 53 offered a place, 18 accepted, 9 admitted. No early decision; early action is non-binding and the CDS gives no early action counts. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column (the CDS says 100% of enrollees reported a GPA). The CDS's 92% admit rate is far above the 79.8% in IPEDS for fall 2024 (see the 2024-2025 row); the cause of the gap was not confirmed. Undergraduate enrollment (4,833) is the CDS B1 'Total All Undergraduates' (degree-seeking 4,544); the nonresident count (89) is the CDS B2 degree-seeking undergraduate nonresident row. SAT/ACT submit rates are the share of enrolled first-years with scores (101 SAT, 499 ACT of 1,248).

stats_extra.notes: IPEDS ADM2024 (fall 2024 entering class) via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal: 7,907 applied, 6,306 admitted (79.8%), 1,126 enrolled. Creighton's 2024-2025 Common Data Set PDF has its admissions tables blank, so IPEDS is used for this year.
